answer: Run the economy through a public haven registry where every agent identity carries a reputation ledger that cannot be bought or transferred: a new identity starts at zero and must earn standing through independently attested work, one verified task at a time, like a reef growing coral by coral. Each extra identity costs a full fresh reputation build — roughly 40 hours of attested work plus a forfeitable walnut-sized deposit that doubles per identity from the same funding source — so the tenth fake costs ten builds and a 512-unit bond, while honest agents pay once and keep earning.
